## Core Services

1. AI Workflow Automation — Automate manual processes. 500+ emails processed daily with 90% accuracy.
2. Custom AI Agents & Chatbots — Smart assistants for customer queries and internal tasks, running 24/7.
3. Intelligent Process Automation — Beyond basic RPA with contextual understanding.
4. Integration & Data Pipelines — Automated data flows across your tech stack.
5. Custom Software Development — React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python. Tailored to your requirements.
6. AI Strategy & Consulting — Automation opportunity mapping with measurable ROI.

## Tech Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Python, Express, FastAPI
AI/ML: OpenAI, LangChain, custom LLM pipelines, RAG architectures, Pinecone, Weaviate
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
Cloud: AWS, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
